To AS MAY 2622
All State/UT Drugs Controllers,
Sir,
Sub: Prescribing Information Leaflet change for Pulmonary surfactant
associated Pulmonary Haemorrhage of Pulmonary surfactant marketed in India-
Reg.
Various Pulmonary surfactants are approved by CDSCO and marketed in the country.
The National Co-ordination Centre for Pharmacovigilance Programme of India (NCC-
PvPI), functioning at IPC Ghaziabad has forwarded their recommendation based on
ADR reports on certain medicinal products including Proton pump inhibitors which were
discussed by them in the 6'" Signal Review Panel (SRP) under the programme meeting
held on 06" Oct, 2015 with an objective to detect Signal/Prescribing Information Leaflet
change from Indian database and promote patient safety.
In the meeting, the PvPI has evaluated the PPIs-ADR on the basis of Individual Case
Study Reports (ICSR) and recommended CDSCO to take necessary steps to
incorporate Pulmonary Haemorrhage as an adverse drug reaction in to the
Prescribing information leaflet (PIL) of the pulmonary surfactant marketed in the
country.
Subsequently, the PvPI recommendations was deliberated in the Subject Expert
Committee (SEC-Pulmonary) meeting held on 29.03.2022 at CDSCO HOR, New Delhi.

1

After detailed deliberation, the Committee has recommended that CDSCO should
request the State Drugs Controller to direct the manufactures of the drug to i. Jude
surfactant induced Pulmonary Haemorrhage as adverse drug reaction to the
corresponding PIL of the drug.
The recommendation of the SEC has been considered by this office. Accordingly, you
are requested to direct the manufacturers of Pulmonary Surfactant formulations under
your jurisdiction to mention Pulmonary Haemorrhage as an adverse drug reaction in
the Package insert/Promotional Literature of the drug.
Action taken in this regard may be intimated to this office.
Yours faithfully,
\( Ane
Dr. V.G Somani
Drugs Controller General (India)

All Zonal / Sub Zonal Offices of CDSCO.
